# Elaren Studio

> Websites, content, social publishing, and local SEO for Arlington, DFW, and Texas teams, alongside our own software products.

Elaren Studio is an app studio and dev shop serving Arlington, Dallas–Fort Worth, and remote Texas teams. We design, ship, and maintain our own software products, take a small number of client builds, and offer clean websites plus scoped content, social publishing, and local SEO. Our stack philosophy is lean: deliberate scope, minimal dependencies, privacy-respecting defaults.

## Products

- **OpusGraph** (live): Music library management for orchestras, choirs, bands, and other performing ensembles—catalog sheet music, track parts, log performance history, and plan seasons, powered by a curated classical music reference database. https://elarenstudio.com/opusgraph/ (app: https://opusgraph.vercel.app)
- **AgentMeter** (shipped, open source): A macOS menu bar app that keeps AI coding usage limits visible at a glance—Codex, Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini, and more. https://elarenstudio.com/agentmeter/ (source: https://github.com/fdtorres1/AgentMeter)
- **Studio Register** (in development): Booking, deposits, agreements, and studio operations for independent photographers. https://elarenstudio.com/studioregister/
- **CareLedger** (in development): A private, local-first pet-care ledger for iPhone—medications, wellness notes, measurements, and timelines that stay on your device. Currently in internal TestFlight.
- **OrchestraOS** (in development): Organization management for performing arts groups—public event pages, registration, ensemble assignment, and admin workflows, in development with its first pilot organization.
- **Mileage Pilot** (in development): Automatic drive detection and mileage records for iPhone, with a classification queue and accounting-friendly CSV export—recorded locally.
- **OmniSearch** (in development): Unified search across the places your work actually lives.

Earlier-stage explorations (unnamed): music notation intelligence and bilingual early-childhood tools.

The storefront and catalog-operations platform behind Resonance Music Press was designed and built by Elaren Studio.

## Services

- **Product Builds**: Scoped v1 and MVP builds for founders and teams. Discovery and honest scoping first; weekly working software; launch with a maintenance path.
- **Custom Applications**: Purpose-built tools for small businesses—booking systems, internal dashboards, workflow apps. Owned by the client, documented for handoff.
- **Websites**: Clean, fast static sites (Astro, Tailwind CSS, global CDN)—designed, launched, and cared for with light monthly care plans.
- **Content & social publishing**: One scoped publishing offer: two articles or existing-page updates (up to 1,000 words each), twelve original posts adapted across up to two existing platforms, one email up to 500 words, supplied-asset design, publishing, basic topic/on-page SEO research, kickoff, one revision, and a concise report. First month $495 for the first two new marketing clients total; $750/month continuation if chosen, held for six months. Month to month, paid in advance after written scope, with no automatic renewal.
- **Local SEO**: One website and one location: a keyword and intent map for up to 10 queries, Search Console baseline and sitemap check, two existing page updates (up to 1,000 words each), and one eligible Google Business Profile review with proposed changes approved before publishing. Ongoing scope is two page updates, GSC/GBP check, and a concise report. Same $495 first month / $750 per month model and boundaries; no ranking, lead, sales, or AI-result promises.

Marketing excludes Website Care, hosting, and technical breakage repair. No paid ads, filming, photo shoots, daily DM/comment management, citation mass cleanup, backlinks, rebuilds, migrations, paid tools, new account verification, or new technical SEO campaigns.

Application work is conversation-priced; there is no public rate card. Start at https://elarenstudio.com/contact/

## Values

- Clarity by design
- Built to endure
- Care that scales
- Respect for your time
